# stb_image.h (v2.30)

Vendored from https://github.com/nothings/stb (single header, public domain / MIT).

Used for optional PNG sprite loading (`ParticleSystem::setSpriteTexture` /
`[system] texture`). If you do not need PNG support you can delete this file
and remove `src/stb_image.cpp` from the build — the built-in gradient sprite
still works.
